Get Nebula with 50% off annual subscription with my link: https://go.nebula.tv/realtimehistory Watch History's Most Daring Raids on Nebula: https://nebula.tv/realtimehistory/historys-most-daring-raids
Saddam Hussein was one of the most notorious dictators of the 2nd half of the 20th century. His rule of Iraq came at a time where the Middle East became a focal point of geopolitics. In his ruthless ambition he started several wars, used weapons of mass destruction on his own population and held Iraq in an iron grip until 2003.

media:group.media:title: Soviet War in Afghanistan 1979-1989 (Full Documentary)
media:group.media:description:
Get 25% off an Obscura VPN subscription for only $6/month: https://obscura.com/REAL
When the Soviet Union invaded Afghanistan in late 1979, the Politburo planned for a quick show of force that would help the fledgling Afghan communist regime to consolidate power. Instead the Soviet Army was embroiled in a 10 year counter insurgency against Afghan mujahedeen and their supporters in Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Iran and the USA.

entry.title: The Failed US Invasion of Canada 1812 (Documentary)

media:group.media:title: The Failed US Invasion of Canada 1812 (Documentary)
media:group.media:description:
Watch our video about the Jesse Elliot Raid: https://nebula.tv/videos/realtimehistory-stealing-royal-navy-ships-the-jesse-elliott-raid-1812
When war broke out in 1812, American leaders anticipated that they could annex Canada before the UK could mount an effective defense. But against smart Canadian and Native American defenders spurred on by the energetic Isaac Brock and marred by logistical problems, the Americans soon find themselves in a military quagmire with mounting losses.

entry.title: 2001 Invasion of Afghanistan: Ousting the Taliban (Documentary)

media:group.media:title: 2001 Invasion of Afghanistan: Ousting the Taliban (Documentary)
media:group.media:description:
Get Nebula with 50% off annual subscription with my link: https://go.nebula.tv/realtimehistory Watch History's Most Daring Raids on Nebula: https://nebula.tv/videos/realtimehistory-taliban-trojan-horse-the-battle-of-qalaijangi-2001
After the 9/11 attacks Afghanistan is the centre of the new "War on Terror" after the country has been largely ignored by the US in the 1990s. To quickly respond, the CIA and CENTCOM devise a new kind of warfare relying on special forces and CIA operators on the ground working in tandem with the Afghan Northern Alliance. Their goal is to capture or kill Osama Bin Laden and if possible topple the Taliban government sheltering him.

media:group.media:description:
